newsitem.title: USA: US Plains feedlot cattle trade at $72 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains feedlot cattle trade at $72 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle traded briskly late Thursday at $72.00 per cwt, breaking a week-long stalemate between packers and cattle owners, feedlot sources said.
Over 50,000 head traded in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area and 25,000 to 30,000 in Kansas, they said.
The trade was unchanged with last week's top price, but cracked a standoff that started Monday when packers bid $70.00 and owners held firm to asking levels of $72.00.
Cattle sellers passed on further bids at $72.00 and were now pricing cattle at $73.00, with no sales early Friday.
